subject.title: fix(music): bound stalled generated audio download body reads

question: Should generated-music timeoutMs be a single wall-clock budget across fetch, status handling, body reads, and retry attempts, even when that can stop a slow but still progressing download or leave less time for a retry?
rationale: The base path already uses a shared provider-operation deadline mechanism, while this PR replaces that path with custom timeout and retry ownership; source review alone cannot choose the intended compatibility semantics.

options.title: Adopt one operation budget
options.body: Confirm that timeoutMs is cumulative across the full generated-music download operation, then require refreshed current-head loopback proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve the prior retry budget
options.body: Keep retries or progressing downloads on the existing shared-provider timing semantics and revise the patch to add only the missing bounded-body behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt one operation budget
recommendation.body: Confirm that timeoutMs is cumulative across the full generated-music download operation, then require refreshed current-head loopback proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently carried the adjacent merged download-timeout work and can clarify the intended sibling contract, though final product acceptance remains a maintainer choice.
